g.text: UML sequence — Consistent statements, terms evidence and authorized retrieval (proposed)
Accept published terms version for selected offer
Authenticated actor, product and document version
Resolve immutable terms version and digest
Commit acceptance linked to party/application/account context
Durable acceptance ID and terms version
Opening balance, period postings, closing balance, watermark
Write immutable versioned statement object + digest
New statement available; no sensitive attachment
Authorize relationship, document and retention access
Redeem bounded reference if direct download is enabled
Supersedes link + reason + new snapshot + outbox
Retention class and legal holds apply to both metadata and objects.
Object write preceding metadata commit may leave an unreferenced
object; recovery reconciles it without publishing incomplete records.
Repeated generation of the same snapshot is idempotent.
FR-DOC-01-04; FR-FIN-04; AT-05/15/16. Access links cannot grant another customer's document rights.
